steps.content: Saina's blade flashes as she lunges, steel aimed straight for Hypatia's throat—a killing blow reserved for mortal foes.
CLANG!

Hypatia's Aurum Secretum petals erupt, shielding Rust and shoving the Alchemic Beast back. In the same motion, she sweeps a current of Aurum Secretum toward Saina, forcing her off course and breaking the lethal trajectory.
Battle after battle has sharpened the girl's instincts; she's now more capable in combat than she knows.
The interception infuriates Saina even more. Steel clashes against Aurum Secretum again and again, the metallic echoes ringing through the ruins, but she cannot break Hypatia's guard.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: What are you all doing? Just standing there gawking?!

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Hold on!
Yokna moves cautiously, trying to hold back the Aurum Secretum Warriors as they ready for battle.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Let's hear the facts first! I don't believe this girl could've done this.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: She's with the Luminaris Society too, and she's helped us before. Why would she kill her own colleague?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Why—?
Saina draws out her words, menacingly stepping toward Yokna.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: To keep you from finding the Hypercubes, obviously. Leave you running in circles forever, beggars in your own WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Do you even know who she is?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Hypatia Campbell. Former administrator of this very place, Furor.
Saina lifts her curved blade, leveling it at Hypatia's face like an executioner delivering judgment.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: And now, back in the same place, you've killed our guide. Planning to leave us all trapped here to die.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Do you really hate farlanders that much?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: The people of Furor trusted you so much... You have no conscience left, do you?
At the word "Furor," the dormant sorcery in Hypatia's mind flares awake once more, stabbing a sudden, sharp pain through her chest.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... that's not true.
Hypatia steadies her breathing, willing her voice into something resembling calm.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I've analyzed the survey data for this region. There is no Hypercube here. The information the Society gave you from the start was fabricated.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: In fact, the Society used the Hypercubes as bait to lure you here... with the intention of using the Mania to kill you all.
Hypatia's explanation hangs in the air, plunging the space into an uneasy silence. The faces of the farland leaders are a mosaic of doubt, denial, and weary suspicion.

After wandering for so long through the dangers of Furor, they have not been without their own uncertainties. But accepting her words means accepting the loss of their last, desperate hope. It's a pain none of them is ready to bear.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: We can't sort this out here. Let's continue this back at camp.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: But whoever's lying, they still want us dead! I say we retreat now, or we'll all be wiped out by the Mania—
[Screen Shakes]

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Argh!
Saina's Alchemic Beast pounces on the merchant, pinning him under its foot.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Shut up, you spineless worm!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: She betrayed Fraser long ago! She conspired with Disians, sold our war plans, left my brothers and sisters... Not one of them came back!
Saina's gaze cuts across the disheveled merchant and the skeptical Yokna, sharp with contempt.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Whatever you worthless lot think... between her and the Aurum Secretum Warriors, this is blood debt!
Hatred is the easiest thing to provoke. It thrives beyond self-interest or morality. As one, the Aurum Secretum Warriors draw their weapons, all aimed at the two before them.
The air grows taut and still, drawn tight as a bowstring.
What should she do? Hypatia glances sidelong at Rust. The crimson glow at the DisCity spy's throat flickers wildly, pulsing like a fading heartbeat.
But thankfully, he's still conscious. For now.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Don't fight them head-on... Listen to me. I'll surrender, create a diversion. When you see the chance... run. Understood? You can make it.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Absolutely not. In our current state, if you're captured, they'll kill you without hesitation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: My status still holds some value to them. But you... they'll show no mercy to someone from DisCity.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I was the one who insisted you bring me here. I cannot... and will not let you die for it!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hah... Don't worry. I can't die. I've still got people who...
Hypatia doesn't yet grasp the deeper meaning of his words, and at that moment, someone else arrives.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Can't die? Let's test that right here. I'll chop you into pieces and see what's left!
With that, Saina lunges again.
The Aurum Secretum weapon arcs toward Saina's flank, but Rael's curved blade intercepts it mid-air, buying a fraction of a second.
It's all the opening Saina needs. She closes the distance to Hypatia in a flash.
Though the Aurum Secretum whips back in defense, the concussive force still hurls Hypatia backward. She crashes into the wall with a sickening thud.
Rot-weakened stone gives way. The wall collapses inward with a roar of dust and debris.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Nngh!
A metallic sweetness floods her mouth. Her body won't respond.
Saina advances, step by deliberate step, blade poised for the final strike. Then, she halts abruptly.
Hypatia lifts her head. Between her and the warrior, she sees it: the tiny Aurum Secretum bird Margaret had given her, fluttering desperately in the line of fire.
It's far too small, too fragile, to stop an enraged Aurum Secretum Warrior. Yet there it is.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Die!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... Don't!
The blade cuts through the air with brutal force, and the Aurum Secretum bird, without making a single sound, is cleaved in two mid-flight.
Then, a dazzling white light erupts from its broken form, engulfing the entire area.
Under the cover of the flash, reinforcements arrive at last.
A figure in pure white descends before the girl, white feathers drifting around her like a gentle blizzard, as if to soothe and purify the world itself.
The DisCity ambassador takes Saina's wrist in a soft grasp, and a strange warmth flows into her body, washing through every nerve.
The sensation tingles, then soothes. As if all her anger has been drawn out, Saina's entire being settles into abrupt tranquility.
Her weapon hits the ground with a clang. The conflict halts.
The newcomer gently waves her fan, offering a radiant, tranquil smile.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Please, let us all compose ourselves. This is hardly the manner for a proper conversation.
Then, shrapnel, arrows, and stray projectiles—all are caught in a gentle embrace of feathers and lowered delicately to the ground.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Margaret!

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You have done exceptionally well. Now, please leave the rest to me.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I am Margaret Kervoz, Peace Ambassador of DisCity. The honor is all mine.
The phrases "DisCity" and "Peace Ambassador" serve as triggers, unleashing an instant wave of reaction.

Whispers, tension, and agitation ripple through the crowd as they fix their eyes on the composed woman before them. What trick did she pull? How was Saina—a demon of death only moments ago—turned docile as a kitten?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Rust, take Hypatia and go. I will handle matters here.
After a swift assessment of both sides' combat strength, the man leans in to deliver a low, urgent whisper.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Hang in there, DisCity's Peace Dove.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Wait, Margaret is still—mmph!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I'm sorry.
He takes a final look at Margaret, surrounded by the crowd, then grabs Hypatia and slips away.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Good. Now that the more... spirited participants have departed, shall we have a proper conversation?
White feathers still drift in the air, like a living barrier, keeping anyone from reaching Hypatia and Rust.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You followed a promise here, filled with hope, seeking the Hypercubes... only to discover a cruel deception. Your efforts were in vain. I share in your outrage and your pain.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I am well aware my presence is unwelcome. I once tried to avoid direct contact, to send intermediaries. But when I saw how you treated a girl who had genuinely aided you in the past, I could no longer remain silent. Knowing the danger, I came anyway.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: She's a Disian... Kill her!

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Mmph...
Margaret gracefully evades the attack, her smile never faltering.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I wish to speak with you all openly and honestly. We are not enemies. DisCity sincerely desires to help you overcome this plight.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Look. I have come without weapons, without guards, without soldiers. Even my special power is merely a "little trick" to calm hostilities and encourage peaceful dialogue.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: What is it you still fear?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I bring nothing but peaceful intent. My presence here is my proof of sincerity to you.
Though her smile is perfect, it fails to soften the hard gazes fixed upon her.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Her power has a limit! Attack her directly!
A sudden storm of weapons—bullets, spears, arrows—descends upon the figure in white.
